 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The isolated emblem in the lower-left is the output shape.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r,c in pts:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        todo=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while todo:
            y,x=todo.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                    seen.add(q); todo.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    # target is the lowest object among those on the left side
    comp=max((p for p in comps if min(x for y,x in p)<w//2), key=lambda p:max(y for y,x in p))
    r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
    c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
    return [[int(grid[y][x]!=0) * grid[y][x] for x in range(c0,c1+1)] for y in range(r0,r1+1)]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
